# Datathon Webpage Code of Conduct
This code of conduct outlines our expectations for participants within the Datathon Webpage community, as well as the consequences for unacceptable behavior. This repository and all related projects from Data Science Club are an extension of LiFE (Liderazgo y Formación Estudiantil) and are governed by Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey (ITESM) policies. Any violations of this code will result on disciplinary action, including but not limited to temporary suspension or permanent ban from the community, aswell as a direct report to the ITESM authorities.

# Our pledge
We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

# Our standards
On the Datathon Webpage community, we are committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all. As such, we expect all participants to adhere to the following standards of behavior:
- Demonstrate empathy and kindness toward other people.
- Be respectful on differing opions and experiences.
- Give and gracefully accept constructive feedback.
- Accept responsibility and apologize to those affected by our mistakes, and learn from the experience.
- Always adhere to the principles of integrity and honesty.

We expect all participants to refrain from:
- Using discriminatory, derogatory, or demeaning language or imagery.
- Harassment, intimidation, or discrimination in any form.
- Public or private harassment.
- Doxxing or sharing private information of others.
- Threats of violence, including violent language directed against another person, fetishism, or other forms of harmful expression.
- Advocating for, or encouraging, any of the above behavior.

# Credits and attribution
It is considered a violation of this code of conduct to take credit for the work of others or to fail to attribute the work of others. This includes, but is not limited to, code, documentation, and other contributions. All contributions must be properly attributed to their original authors even if they are modified or adapted.

For commit messages and authorship, please use the following command to ensure proper attribution:
```sh
git commit --author="Author Name <author@example.com>" -m "Description of the changes made."
```
Failure to properly attribute contributions may result in disciplinary action, more on that in the [Enforcement](#enforcement) section.

# Enforcement
Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported by contacting the project team.

All complaints will be reviewed and investigated and will result in a response that is deemed necessary and appropriate to the circumstances. The project team is obligated to maintain confidentiality with regard to the reporter of an incident. Further details of specific enforcement policies may be posted separately.
| Violation / Offense | Consequence | Resolution & Enforcement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minor behavioral issues** | Warning | Behavior correction required. |
| **Obscene language** | Warning | Content deleted; behavior correction required. |
| **Non-sensitive data leaks (accidental)** | Warning | Data leak addressed and remediated. |
| **Repeated behavioral issues** | Temporary Suspension | Suspended for a specified period; behavior correction required. |
| **Inappropriate content** | Temporary Suspension | Content deleted; suspended for a specified period. |
| **Sensitive data leaks (accidental)** | Temporary Suspension | Data leak remediated; suspended for a specified period. |
| **Plagiarism (first offense)** | Temporary Suspension | Suspended for improper attribution. |
| **Harassment, threats, or discrimination** | Permanent Ban | Permanently banned and reported to ITESM authorities. |
| **Repeated plagiarism** | Permanent Ban | Permanently banned and reported to ITESM authorities. |
| **Intentional or repeated sensitive data leaks** | Permanent Ban | Permanently banned and reported to ITESM authorities. |

> [!WARNING]
> Such table is not exhaustive and the project team reserves the right to take any action they deem appropriate, including but not limited to those listed above, in response to any behavior that violates this code of conduct.

> [!NOTE]
> Check ITESM student code of conduct for more information on disciplinary actions and consequences. Link: https://tec.mx/es/profesional/politicas-y-reglamentos
